********************************************************************************
nanobeep by utz 09'2015 - 04'2016
2 channel beeper engine for ZX Spectrum
********************************************************************************

nanobeep is a tiny 2-channel PFM beeper engine with an interrupting click drum.
The full upstream README and current source are authoritative at:
https://github.com/tuklusan/ZX-Spectrum-1-Bit-Routines/tree/master/nanobeep

Carrom Arena vendors the original main.asm beside this note for provenance and
uses a callable adaptation in src/nanobeep.asm. See ../LICENSE.
